findings.evidence: All active factual claims resolve to locally archived CSRC, SSE or fund-manager primary PDFs; the 14-record archive manifest still matches every registered record.
findings.fix_required: Do not translate historical distributions, fund performance or product labels into a forward return, cash-receipt or implementation claim.
findings.resolution: Each source is bounded to historical fact or product mechanism. The active framework has one conditional total-return objective, no cash-receipt objective, and q=0 for all market candidates.
